evidence: Route: explicit code labels in the study's own questionnaire + cell-level source tie (verify_nguyen_2026_autonomy_academic_pressure.R). (1) Questionnaire.docx (sha256 82891eef...) statement table prints AP1..AP3 each beside its item; shipped item_text equals the text printed against its code 3/3 verbatim. (2) Live table (4467 rows, 1489 ids) vs deposit xlsx (1489 rows): live resp for each (id, APk) equals xlsx row id, column APk in 100% of cells for all 3 items; agreement with any other AP column is 0.34-0.46 (best 0.461), so no two items can be swapped undetected. Every item is distinguished from every other. Not established: that the depositor filled xlsx column APk from questionnaire item APk (the depositor's own code labelling, taken as authoritative; no article with per-item statistics exists), nor the anchor direction, which rests on the questionnaire's '1 = Strongly disagree -> 5 = Strongly agree' line (possible block reversal flagged in notes, unproven).
